_comment: Gates the MATLAB driver CANNOT measure, and therefore does not silently
omit: they run in another language binding, under another compiler, in
another repo, or against a historical pre-fix engine binary that no
longer exists in the tree.  Each entry records the command that produces
it and the date it was captured; the report labels every one of them as
externally sourced, with that date, so a reader can tell at a glance
which numbers `make polval-regen` refreshed and which it did not.
Update protocol: re-run the command, paste the result here, bump
'captured'.  Do NOT copy any of these into the report prose -- the prose

X_MMACOS_SUITE.note: fast 281 / masks 62 / freeform 46 / proper-512 10 / proper-1024 13; gfortran-linked mex

X_PYMACOS_SUITE.gate: pymacos pytest suite (ifx-linked = the standing ifx smoke)

X_PROPER_RESIDUAL.gate: ladder 3 -- polarized PROPER re-run reproduces the committed scalar residual EXACTLY, for both polarization-off and polarization-on/vector-off

X_PROPER_VECDIFF.gate: ladder 3 -- vector run differs from scalar on the Coro near-field leg at identical total power; attribution UNVERIFIED

X_GMI.gate: GMI regression -- polarization work must be a no-op on polarization-off prescriptions

X_PREFIX_FF_TOTAL.gate: ladder 5 -- far-field vector total power BEFORE the PFFPROP->FFPROP*3 unification
X_PREFIX_FF_TOTAL.command: rebuild the engine with propsub.F at a0f6dba^, then re-run the ladder-5 case
X_PREFIX_FF_TOTAL.note: HISTORICAL. Requires rebuilding the pre-fix engine; not reproducible from the current tree. The post-fix counterpart (G35_VECTOR_TOT) IS regenerated every run.

X_PREFIX_VECCHAIN.gate: non-vacuity -- the pre-fix engine FAILS the vector-chain gates
X_PREFIX_VECCHAIN.command: rebuild the engine with propsub.F at a0f6dba^, then run tVecChain
X_PREFIX_VECCHAIN.note: HISTORICAL. 0.21 after one leg, 0.38 after two.

X_PREFIX_POWER.gate: non-vacuity -- the pre-fix engine also mis-states total power
X_PREFIX_POWER.command: rebuild the engine with propsub.F at a0f6dba^, then run tVecChain
